Let's set time. Let t be hours after 09:10. Train A position from A: x1 = 84 t, until meet. Train B leaves at 10:05, which is 55 min after 09:10 = 55/60 = 11/12 h. For t >= 11/12, position from A: x2 = 391 - 106 (t - 11/12). Meet when x1 = x2.

84 t = 391 - 106(t - 11/12) = 391 -106t + 106*11/12. 106*11/12 = 1166/12 = 583/6 = 97.1666667. So 84t = 391 + 583/6 -106t. 391 = 2346/6. Sum = 2929/6. Then 190t = 2929/6 => t = 2929/(1140) hours. Convert to h:min: 0.5692982456*60 = 34.1578947 min. So 2h 34.1579 min = 2h 34 min 9.4737 sec. Meeting time = 11:44:09.47 approx. Let's verify: 09:10 + 2:34:09.47 = 11:44:09.47.
